name: Potion of Extirpation
description: An acrid, tarry substance in an iron flask with a lead stopper.
benefit: You can pour the potion on one object or creature filling up to a close area. The target is utterly removed from reality and cannot be returned by anything short of a wish spell.

name: Potion of Flying
description: A sunny liquid with bubbles that flash and pop like tiny stars.
benefit: You can fly a near distance when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Forgetfulness
description: A pink draught that swirls with a counter-clockwise current.
benefit: If you serve this potion to an intelligent being and that being drinks it, the imbiber permanently forgets one memory of your choosing.

name: Potion of Healing
description: A glass bottle with a fizzy, lemon-vanilla liquid inside.
benefit: The imbiber of this potion regains hit points based on their level. 1d6 hit points (0-3), 2d8 hit points (4-6), 3d10 hit points (7-9), 4d12 hit points (10+).

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: This glass vial appears to be empty, but a liquid audibly splashes around inside it.
benefit: When you drink this potion you become invisible until you attack or cast a spell.

name: Potion of Legendary Deeds
description: A golden elixir that resonates with a faint, angelic chord.
benefit: When you drink this potion you gain one level and your XP total resets to zero.

name: Potion of Polymorph
description: A pickled newt floats in this lavender flask of clear liquid
benefit: When you drink this potion it casts the polymorph spell on you.

name: Potion of Vitality
description: A crimson elixir that gently thumps with a heartbeat.
benefit: When you drink this potion, roll your class's hit points die. You permanently gain that many HP.
curse: If you drink more than one Potion of Vitality in your lifetime, you must pass a DC18 CON check each time or die instantly.

name: Potion of Mental Prowess
description: A vibrant pink and purple liquid swirls, even when sitting still.
benefit: When you drink this potion your mental stats; intelligence, wisdom, and charisma, are increased by 1.

name: Potion of Mental Perfection
description: A vibrant pink and red liquid swirls, even when sitting still.
benefit: When you drink this potion your mental stats; intelligence, wisdom, and charisma, are increased by 2.

name: Potion of Physical Prowess
description: A vibrant cyan and purple liquid swirls, even when sitting still.
benefit: When you drink this potion your physical stats; strength, dexterity, and constitution, are increased by 1.

name: Potion of Physical Perfection
description: A vibrant cyan and blue liquid swirls, even when sitting still.
benefit: When you drink this potion your physical stats; strength, dexterity, and constitution, are increased by 2.

name: Potion of Wraith Sight
description: The container barely contains the smokey black substance as it expands and shrinks.
benefit: When you drink this potion you're able to see living creatures, invisible or otherwise.

name: Potion of Radiance
description: Vibrant orange and white liquid emanates a soft glow.
benefit: Glow brightly (up to near) for a short duration.

name: Potion of Heightened Understanding
description: A verdant elixir that bubbles and smells of various herbs when opened.
benefit: When you drink this potion you receive a +1 to spell casting checks.

name: Potion of Combat Expertise
description: An azure elixir that bubbles and smells of various fruits when opened.
benefit: When you drink this potion you receive a +1 to attack rolls.
